raw_responses.Bulgarian:
This is a sunburst chart (or two-level pie chart) that displays hierarchical data across two concentric rings. 

*   **Inner Ring (Main Categories):** Divided into three sectors. 
    *   "Virtual Characters" is the largest sector, colored light blue, taking up roughly two-thirds of the circle.
    *   "Real Characters" is colored light green, taking up roughly 15-20%.
    *   "Custom Characters" is colored pink, taking up the smallest share, roughly 10-15%.
*   **Outer Ring (Subcategories):** Divided into 13 visible sectors that correspond to the inner categories, colored in lighter shades of their parent category.
    *   Adjacent to the blue "Virtual Characters" are five very light blue sectors labeled: "Comic Characters" (the largest), "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", and "Game Characters".
    *   Adjacent to the pink "Custom Characters" is a single very light pink sector with no text label.
    *   Adjacent to the green "Real Characters" are seven very light green sectors labeled: "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers".
*   **Labels and Formatting:** Text labels are placed directly inside or just outside their respective sectors. The text colors match the category themes (blue text for virtual, black for the inner real/custom labels, and green for the outer real labels). 
*   **Missing Elements:** There are no explicit percentage values provided, no separate legend, and no exploded or visually emphasized slices. The subcategories do not appear to be strictly ordered by size.

DESCRIPTION:
Изображението представлява двустепенна кръгова диаграма, която категоризира различни видове персонажи в три основни групи във вътрешния кръг и техните подкатегории във външния пръстен, обхващайки общо 3 основни и 13 подкатегорийни сектора. Вътрешният кръг е разделен на три сектора: „Virtual Characters“ (светлосин цвят, заемащ най-голям дял от приблизително 65-70%), „Real Characters“ (светлозелен цвят, около 15-20%) и „Custom Characters“ (розов цвят, около 10-15%). Външният пръстен съдържа подкатегории, оцветени в по-светли нюанси на съответните основни цветове. Подкатегориите на „Virtual Characters“ са пет много светлосини сектора с етикети „Comic Characters“, „Movie Characters“, „Teleplay Characters“, „Novel Characters“ и „Game Characters“. Секторът „Custom Characters“ е заобиколен от един много светлорозов сектор без допълнителен етикет. Подкатегориите на „Real Characters“ се състоят от седем много светлозелени сектора с етикети „Scientists“, „Artists“, „Athletes“, „Writers“, „Musicians“, „Actors“ и „Influencers“. Диаграмата не включва отделна легенда, нито етикети с точни проценти вътре в секторите, и нито един от секторите не е визуално подчертан чрез отделяне или удебеляване. Сегментите във външния пръстен не изглеждат подредени по строг низходящ или възходящ размер.
raw_responses.English:
This figure is a multi-level pie chart, also known as a sunburst chart, that displays a hierarchical categorization of character types. The chart consists of 16 total slices arranged across two concentric levels: an inner core with three main categories and an outer ring with thirteen subcategories. The inner ring is divided into "Virtual Characters" (solid blue, occupying approximately 60% of the chart), "Real Characters" (solid green, approximately 25%), and "Custom Characters" (solid pink, approximately 15%). The outer ring further subdivides these main categories using lighter shades of the corresponding colors. The light blue section for "Virtual Characters" contains five slices labeled "Comic Characters" (the largest), "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters." The light green section for "Real Characters" is divided into seven slices labeled "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers." The light pink section corresponding to "Custom Characters" consists of a single, unlabeled outer slice. Labels are placed directly on or adjacent to their respective slices, with the outer text colored to match their category's hue (dark blue for virtual, dark green for real). The chart does not include a separate legend, numerical percentage labels, or visually emphasized slices such as exploded segments, and the subcategories within the outer ring do not appear to be strictly ordered by size.

raw_responses.German:
Based on the visual structure of the figure, here is the step-by-step analysis:
1.  **Chart Type:** It is a multi-level pie chart, commonly known as a sunburst chart, consisting of an inner ring (main categories) and an outer ring (sub-categories).
2.  **Inner Ring (Main Categories):** There are three segments.
    *   "Virtual Characters": Colored solid light blue, dominating the chart (roughly 75% of the circle).
    *   "Custom Characters": Colored solid pink, taking up roughly 10-15%.
    *   "Real Characters": Colored solid light green, taking up roughly 10-15%.
3.  **Outer Ring (Sub-categories):** There are 13 visible segments in total, colored in paler shades of their parent categories.
    *   *Light Blue (Virtual):* 5 segments labeled "Comic Characters" (the largest), "Movie Characters", "Teleplay Characters", "Novel Characters", and "Game Characters".
    *   *Pale Pink (Custom):* 1 large segment with no text label.
    *   *Pale Green (Real):* 7 segments labeled "Scientists", "Artists", "Athletes", "Writers", "Musicians", "Actors", and "Influencers". These vary in size.
4.  **Labels and Colors:** Labels are placed directly on or adjacent to the segments. The text color in the outer ring matches the hue of the category (dark blue text for the blue section, dark green text for the green section). Inner ring text is black.
5.  **Other Features:** There are no numerical values or percentages provided. There is no separate legend. No segments are exploded (offset) or visually highlighted beyond their standard coloring.

DESCRIPTION:
Das vorliegende mehrstufige Kreisdiagramm (Sunburst-Diagramm) veranschaulicht die hierarchische Verteilung verschiedener Charaktertypen. Der innere Kreis besteht aus drei Hauptkategorien: „Virtual Characters“ (hellblau, nimmt mit schätzungsweise 75 Prozent den deutlich größten Anteil ein), „Custom Characters“ (rosa, schätzungsweise 10 bis 15 Prozent) und „Real Characters“ (hellgrün, schätzungsweise 10 bis 15 Prozent). Der äußere Ring unterteilt diese Hauptbereiche in insgesamt 13 sichtbare Segmente. Der Bereich der „Virtual Characters“ fächert sich in fünf blassblaue äußere Segmente auf, die als „Comic Characters“ (das flächenmäßig größte dieser Gruppe), „Movie Characters“, „Teleplay Characters“, „Novel Characters“ und „Game Characters“ beschriftet sind. Die Kategorie „Custom Characters“ wird im äußeren Ring durch ein einziges, unbeschriftetes blassrosa Segment fortgeführt. Der Bereich der „Real Characters“ unterteilt sich in sieben blassgrüne äußere Segmente unterschiedlicher Größe mit den Bezeichnungen „Scientists“, „Artists“, „Athletes“, „Writers“, „Musicians“, „Actors“ und „Influencers“. Die Beschriftungen sind direkt auf oder neben den jeweiligen Segmenten platziert, wobei die Textfarben im äußeren Ring der jeweiligen farblichen Grundkategorie angepasst sind (blau für virtuell, grün für real). Das Diagramm enthält keine separate Legende, keine expliziten Prozentangaben und keine visuell hervorgehobenen oder versetzten Segmente.
